title: Slaanesh Expanded - Visuals
author: Narok-
description:
Note: This is an Alpha version test. Updates will come eventually, but won't play nice with other mods that change appearances.

Summary:

This submod is designed to work with Zeta's Total Warmaidens III (Original Females Edition):

<https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/22>

Its purpose is to align with my other mods by keeping the female Legendary Lords (LL) in their default outfits until they are subjugated by the player—either through vassalization or confederation. At that point, they succumb to the influence of Slaanesh.

Currently, this submod supports the following Legendary Lords (LLs):

-
Alarielle

-
Elspeth

-
Fay Enchantress

-
Hellebron

-
Katarin

-
Miao Ying

-
Morathi

-
Repanse

-
Sisters of Twilight

Additional info:

-

Work in Progress: At present, only the specific Legendary Lords listed above are affected by this mod. All other female lords and units will start the game without clothing until further updates are made.

-

Customization Option: If you prefer to restore clothing to all other units and are familiar with using RPFM, you can manually delete the unwanted files by navigating to @Total Warmaidens III (Original Females Edition) and removing files in variantmeshes > variantmeshdefinitions.

-

Future Plans: Eventually this mod will develop enough where players can customize their experience in-game, without the need for manual RPFM edits.
